title: Evenness of the Rademacher norm
statement: Let $V$ be a real normed vector space and let $w_1,\\ldots,w_n\\in V$. The function on sign vectors defined by $x\\mapsto\\left\\|\\sum_{i=1}^n x_i w_i\\right\\|$ is even: its value at $-x$ equals its value at $x$ for every sign vector $x$.
hypotheses_covered: V is a real normed vector space
w assigns a vector in V to each of the n coordinates
